title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘notes that EU debt securities could serve as a benchmark, thereby strengthening the integration of EU financial markets;’ and ‘calls for the introduction of new own resources to finance the Union’s policies;’
part_context: Believes that the EU economic governance framework should be complemented by EU-level instruments and tools, where appropriate, in order to minimise the costs for EU taxpayers and maximise efficiency in the provision of European public goods and to respond to Union-wide crises, such as the ongoing crisis in the area of security and defence; <del>notes that EU debt securities could serve as a benchmark, thereby strengthening the integration of EU financial markets;</del> calls for the introduction of new own resources to finance the Union’s policies; supports the creation of the European Competitiveness Fund and the Scaleup Europe Fund;
